name: Bloodstate
storyline:
A classified military recovery operation is launched after all communication is lost with a remote industrial quarantine zone. Intelligence reports suggest that a specimen recovered from the area may hold the key to understanding — or controlling — the outbreak.

The mission quickly collapses.

Separated from the rest of the team and surrounded by infected, the player becomes the sole survivor. With supplies running low and extraction impossible, survival becomes the only objective.

As the player pushes deeper through abandoned facilities, industrial districts, military checkpoints, and infected strongholds, they begin uncovering evidence that the outbreak was neither accidental nor fully understood by those attempting to contain it.

Power systems must be restored, routes reopened, and critical infrastructure reactivated in order to reach the next Advance Point. Along the way, players encounter increasingly dangerous infected variants, military remnants, and signs that something far worse may be spreading beneath the surface.

The infection is not only a threat to humanity, it is a threat to the player. Every encounter risks contamination, and as the infection progresses, the line between survivor and infected begins to blur.

The truth behind the outbreak remains buried somewhere inside the quarantine zone. Reaching it may be the only way to survive.
summary:
Bloodstate is a first-person zombie survival horror game developed by KAIGEN. Players take on the role of the sole survivor of a failed military operation and must fight their way through infected territory while restoring power, scavenging resources, and uncovering the truth behind a catastrophic outbreak.

The game features mission-based progression, large-scale horde encounters, dynamic zombie dismemberment, infection management, and a variety of special infected with unique behaviors. Players must search for weapons, ammunition, medical supplies, batteries, and infection cures while navigating dangerous environments filled with hostile infected.

Special infected include ELENA, a highly infectious female infected; STALKER packs, crawler-type predators that hunt and drag victims to feeding locations; MAUL, a massive infected capable of devastating area attacks; Zombie Dogs; and Dark Infected that avoid sunlight and lurk within buildings and shadowed areas.

Additional gameplay features include enterable buildings, destructible routes, environmental interactions, night vision gameplay, military support events, helicopter flyovers, weapon scavenging, and progression through interconnected missions and Advance Points.

Built in Unity 6 HDRP, BLOODSTATE combines atmospheric exploration, survival mechanics, and large-scale infected encounters into a single-player zombie survival horror experience.
